question: Is NAE faithful on every 6-regular torus with 49 to 80 distinctions and Klein bottle with 19 to 40 of edge-width at least 5, and on tori of edge-width at least 6 is bond distance graph distance + 1 out to distance 3?

definitions.worlds: Every 6-regular triangulated torus with 49..80 distinctions (lattice modulo a sublattice) and Klein bottle with 19..40 (lattice modulo translations and a glide), one per isomorphism class (flag codes).
definitions.edge-width: Least lattice distance from a point to its image under a non-identity deck element.
definitions.distance-3 reading: On each faithful torus of edge-width >= 6, from distinction 0: for every v at graph distance 3, no 4-element bond through 0 and v over all pairs of other distinctions, and a 5-element bond among distinctions within distance 2 of 0 or v; at distance 2, a 4-element bond nearby (the lemma's check). Patterns by a 4,000-state sample (seed 20261114 + world index), then SAT for unseen patterns.
definitions.settled: Distance 1 by definition; distance 2 by the lemma in the pre-registration (proved, to be refereed); states exist on large tori (Hutchinson, Richter and Seymour).

public_inputs.code: census.py (sha256 7a338c7599f4cc66db60b0adfadc8909431a19871ae8d27e3214a74879fc362a) and flat_worlds.py (sha256 3450f36a403937f7bc429c9f9b7a9ec0cb5175caa10c872199070a998b24ccef) beside this file; KNOTS-ALONE's knots_alone.py; pysat Minisat22; 12 worker processes.
public_inputs.run: census.py from the repository root; output artifacts/LONG-LOOP-20261111-001A/LONG-LOOP-20261111-001A-E001_long_loops/census.json and census_log.txt.

forbidden_inputs: Changing the world list, thresholds, readings, seeds or predictions after seeing results
primary_observable: Per world: edge-width and NAE's reading; per measured torus: the distance-2 and distance-3 bond findings.
cheapest_meaningful_control: Glide Klein bottles against the SAT Klein bottles at 7..16 by isomorphism class; six 21-distinction tori outside the list run before freezing (the distance-3 search finds the known shortcuts at edge-width 4).

predictions.P1: NAE faithful on every world in the list of edge-width >= 5.
predictions.P2: On every faithful torus of edge-width >= 6, beta = delta + 1 for delta <= 3 (no 4-bond at distance 3, a 5-bond nearby).

decision_rules.both hold: A63 overturned in the knots-alone setting with the surface count given, on computed evidence in range.

runtime: About half an hour on 12 workers; registered; systemd-run --user -p MemoryMax=16G -p MemorySwapMax=0.
